## Easier to read

A contrast review of every screen in both themes and all accent colours, against WCAG 2.2 AA
(4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for controls and indicators).

- Selected rows, tabs, tiles and settings categories now have a clear outline.
- Buttons and links keep enough contrast on hover and press in every accent colour.
- Placeholder text, dimmed log text and saved-device labels are darker (or lighter on dark).
- Log level colours and the device status dot use colours chosen for each theme.
- Scrollbars, switch outlines, dropdown borders, error messages and selected text are easier to see.

## More on screen

- Commands open in the list view. The grid view is one click away.
- Grid tiles are more compact: about twice as many fit on screen.

## Updating

From 1.6.2 or 1.7.0 on Windows, use the **Update now** banner or Settings > Updates. Versions
before 1.6.2 cannot download updates: install this version by hand once.
